# fpp3

## Overview

The fpp3 package contains data used in the book [*Forecasting:
Principles and Practice* (3rd edition)](https://OTexts.com/fpp3/) by Rob
J Hyndman and George Athanasopoulos. It also loads several packages
needed to do the analysis described in the book. These packages work
with the [tidyverse](https://tidyverse.org/) set of packages, sharing
common data representations and API design. Additional data sets not
used in the book are also included.

## Installation

You can install the **stable** version from
[CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=fpp3).

``` r
pak::pak("fpp3")
```

You can install the **development** version from
[Github](https://github.com/robjhyndman/fpp3)

``` r
# install.packages("remotes")
pak::pak("robjhyndman/fpp3")
```

## Usage

[`library(fpp3)`](https://pkg.robjhyndman.com/fpp3/) will load the
following packages:

- [tibble](https://tibble.tidyverse.org), for tibbles, a modern
  re-imagining of data frames.
- [dplyr](https://dplyr.tidyverse.org), for data manipulation.
- [tidyr](https://tidyr.tidyverse.org), to tidy data.
- [lubridate](https://lubridate.tidyverse.org), for dates/times.
- [ggplot2](https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org), for data visualisation.
- [tsibble](https://tsibble.tidyverts.org), for tsibbles, a time series
  version of a tibble.
- [tsibbledata](https://tsibbledata.tidyverts.org), various time series
  data sets in the form of tsibbles.
- [ggtime](https://ggtime.tidyverts.org), for time series visualisation.
- [feasts](https://feasts.tidyverts.org), for features and statistics of
  time series.
- [fable](https://fable.tidyverts.org), for fitting models and producing
  forecasts.

You also get a condensed summary of conflicts with other packages you
have loaded:

``` r
library(fpp3)
#> ── Attaching packages ──────────────────────────────────────────── fpp3 1.0.3 ──
#> ✔ tibble      3.3.1     ✔ tsibble     1.2.0
#> ✔ dplyr       1.2.0     ✔ tsibbledata 0.4.1
#> ✔ tidyr       1.3.2     ✔ ggtime      0.2.0
#> ✔ lubridate   1.9.5     ✔ feasts      0.5.0
#> ✔ ggplot2     4.0.2     ✔ fable       0.5.0
#> ── Conflicts ───────────────────────────────────────────────── fpp3_conflicts ──
#> ✖ lubridate::date()    masks base::date()
#> ✖ dplyr::filter()      masks stats::filter()
#> ✖ tsibble::intersect() masks base::intersect()
#> ✖ tsibble::interval()  masks lubridate::interval()
#> ✖ dplyr::lag()         masks stats::lag()
#> ✖ tsibble::setdiff()   masks base::setdiff()
#> ✖ tsibble::union()     masks base::union()
```

# Package index

## Package

- [`fpp3`](https://pkg.robjhyndman.com/fpp3package/reference/fpp3-package.md)
  [`fpp3-package`](https://pkg.robjhyndman.com/fpp3package/reference/fpp3-package.md)
  : fpp3: Data for "Forecasting: Principles and Practice" (3rd Edition)

## Functions

- [`fpp3_conflicts()`](https://pkg.robjhyndman.com/fpp3package/reference/fpp3_conflicts.md)
  : Conflicts between fpp3 packages and other packages
- [`fpp3_packages()`](https://pkg.robjhyndman.com/fpp3package/reference/fpp3_packages.md)
  : List all packages loaded by fpp3

## Data

- [`aus_airpassengers`](https://pkg.robjhyndman.com/fpp3package/reference/aus_airpassengers.md)
  : Air Transport Passengers Australia
- [`aus_accommodation`](https://pkg.robjhyndman.com/fpp3package/reference/aus_accommodation.md)
  : Australian accommodation data
- [`aus_arrivals`](https://pkg.robjhyndman.com/fpp3package/reference/aus_arrivals.md)
  : International Arrivals to Australia
- [`aus_births`](https://pkg.robjhyndman.com/fpp3package/reference/aus_births.md)
  : Australian births data
- [`aus_fertility`](https://pkg.robjhyndman.com/fpp3package/reference/aus_fertility.md)
  : Australian fertility rates
- [`aus_inbound`](https://pkg.robjhyndman.com/fpp3package/reference/aus_inbound.md)
  : Monthly short term (\<1 year) visitor arrivals to Australia
- [`aus_migration`](https://pkg.robjhyndman.com/fpp3package/reference/aus_migration.md)
  : Australian migration data
- [`aus_mortality`](https://pkg.robjhyndman.com/fpp3package/reference/aus_mortality.md)
  : Australian mortality data
- [`aus_outbound`](https://pkg.robjhyndman.com/fpp3package/reference/aus_outbound.md)
  : Monthly short term (\<1 year) resident departures in Australia
- [`aus_tobacco`](https://pkg.robjhyndman.com/fpp3package/reference/aus_tobacco.md)
  : Australian cigarette and tobacco expenditure
- [`aus_vehicle_sales`](https://pkg.robjhyndman.com/fpp3package/reference/aus_vehicle_sales.md)
  : Australian vehicle sales
- [`bank_calls`](https://pkg.robjhyndman.com/fpp3package/reference/bank_calls.md)
  : Call volume for a large North American commercial bank
- [`boston_marathon`](https://pkg.robjhyndman.com/fpp3package/reference/boston_marathon.md)
  : Boston marathon winning times since 1897
- [`canadian_gas`](https://pkg.robjhyndman.com/fpp3package/reference/canadian_gas.md)
  : Monthly Canadian gas production
- [`guinea_rice`](https://pkg.robjhyndman.com/fpp3package/reference/guinea_rice.md)
  : Rice production (Guinea)
- [`insurance`](https://pkg.robjhyndman.com/fpp3package/reference/insurance.md)
  : Insurance quotations and advertising expenditure
- [`melb_walkers`](https://pkg.robjhyndman.com/fpp3package/reference/melb_walkers.md)
  : Average daily total pedestrian count in Melbourne
- [`nsw_offences`](https://pkg.robjhyndman.com/fpp3package/reference/nsw_offences.md)
  : Monthly offences in NSW
- [`ny_childcare`](https://pkg.robjhyndman.com/fpp3package/reference/ny_childcare.md)
  : New York childcare data
- [`otexts_views`](https://pkg.robjhyndman.com/fpp3package/reference/otexts_views.md)
  : OTexts page views
- [`prices`](https://pkg.robjhyndman.com/fpp3package/reference/prices.md)
  : Price series for various commodities
- [`souvenirs`](https://pkg.robjhyndman.com/fpp3package/reference/souvenirs.md)
  : Sales for a souvenir shop
- [`us_change`](https://pkg.robjhyndman.com/fpp3package/reference/us_change.md)
  : Percentage changes in economic variables in the USA.
- [`us_employment`](https://pkg.robjhyndman.com/fpp3package/reference/us_employment.md)
  : US monthly employment data
- [`us_gasoline`](https://pkg.robjhyndman.com/fpp3package/reference/us_gasoline.md)
  : US finished motor gasoline product supplied.
